verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents its own prebuilt Connectors (Gmail, Salesforce, Slack, and so on) that users add to agents. It also offers no-auth connectors where Gumloop supplies a managed API key, and app triggers for external services. Nothing shows the catalog reaches thousands of apps, and custom MCP connections are user-built, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of catalog breadth at thousands-of-apps scale, a documented connector catalog/list, confirmation that integrations are vendor-maintained, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations

citations.quote: Open the Connectors section and add the integrations the agent needs (Gmail, Salesforce, Slack, and so on).
add one to an agent and it works on the first run, either because the data is public or because Gumloop supplies a managed API key behind the scenes
app triggers to fire when something happens in an external service
